sources.role: Field index and common inspector reference; does not establish complete 30-field property acceptance
Phone format and optional SMS verification; local SMS and TEXTPHONE remain unsupported
Structured location and device/map/default constraints absent in current text-only control
OCR image/rule/target field path absent in current paste-text control
Signature add/confirm/phone orientation/member reuse and desktop QR differ from inline canvas; no ordinary import/export

code_change.description: Omit default/length controls for new phone fields; retain configured legacy default and unusual length controls; no schema/runtime/backend change
regression: Legacy defaults remain editable and used as runtime defaults
Stable ID and schema parsing preserve configured values
